<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to an SNAr reaction (halide replaced by amine). We have the target molecule SMILES from the previous step: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1". We'll search the template catalog for a template that breaks a halide and forms an amine, typical of SNAr. Then we will apply that template to the target molecule to get possible precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
